segments.text: Come closer. Let me take you back. This story starts with a window and a fight for the view.
Back when the web was young, two giants fought to frame the view
Netscape faced Explorer for the window we looked through
Netscape opened up its code,
let more hands inside the frame.
Mozilla kept the work alive,
then Firefox stepped into the game.
Add a button, block the track,
and make the browser fit your day.
Look beneath the painted surface,
change the way the pieces play.
More eyes checking all the wiring,
more hands working at the seams.
The doorway had a handle on our side of the screen.
Who owns your doorway?
Who decides what you can see?
Let me look, let me change it
Leave the final say with me
Open up the app, see your friend I know
Find a little shop, watch your garden grow
Every time I pause, every clip I save
Gives the feed of clue shapes the next display
I can view the voice, I can choose a friend
But the app still sorts what it wants to send
I can choose who I follow, can I see how you choose for me?
Let me look, let me change it, leave the final say with me
Make a workshop page, here's the time and place
Use the notes I gave, leave some breathing space
Show me what you wrote, that sounds like a sale
They'll tell them what they'll learn, give the plain details
Check the date again, make the link work right
Wait until I save and put the page online
Save a note for me, clear words, skip the pitch
Read it next time, round, let me edit it
The model works with words and app connects the tools
We call that app a harness, we get to choose its rules
Let me see its notes, let me set its reach
If I change the model, keep the work with me
Show the plan, let me choose Ask before you use my tools, let me look, let me change it
Leave the final say with me
Who owns the toaster? I choose the bread
I buy the power, the tool stays mine
Keep the notes I made, keep the tools I choose
When I change the model, keep my work with me
Let me look, let me change it, leave my work with me
Same old question, a new machine
Let me look, let me change it, let me change it
Leave the final say with me.
